mapper.select: SELECT c.post_comment_id, c.parent_post_comment_id, c.user_id, u.name AS author_name, CONCAT('/uploads/', t.file_path) AS author_thumbnail_url, IF(m.status = 'ACTIVE', c.mention_user_id, NULL) AS mention_user_id, IF(m.status = 'ACTIVE', m.name, NULL) AS mention_user_name, c.content, c.status, c.created_at, c.updated_at, (c.user_id = #{userId}) AS mine FROM post_comment c JOIN users u ON u.user_id = c.user_id LEFT JOIN thumbnail_image t ON t.user_id = u.user_id AND t.target_type = 'USER' AND t.target_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN users m ON m.user_id = c.mention_user_id WHERE c.post_id = #{postId} ORDER BY c.post_comment_id

SELECT c.post_comment_id, c.parent_post_comment_id, c.user_id, u.name AS author_name, CONCAT('/uploads/', t.file_path) AS author_thumbnail_url, IF(m.status = 'ACTIVE', c.mention_user_id, NULL) AS mention_user_id, IF(m.status = 'ACTIVE', m.name, NULL) AS mention_user_name, c.content, c.status, c.created_at, c.updated_at, (c.user_id = #{userId}) AS mine FROM post_comment c JOIN users u ON u.user_id = c.user_id LEFT JOIN thumbnail_image t ON t.user_id = u.user_id AND t.target_type = 'USER' AND t.target_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN users m ON m.user_id = c.mention_user_id WHERE c.post_comment_id = #{postCommentId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO post_comment (user_id, post_id, parent_post_comment_id, mention_user_id, content) VALUES (#{userId}, #{postId}, #{parentPostCommentId}, #{mentionUserId}, #{content})
mapper.update: UPDATE post_comment SET content = #{content}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE post_comment_id = #{postCommentId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'NORMAL'
UPDATE post_comment SET status = 'DELETED', deleted_at = NOW() WHERE post_comment_id = #{postCommentId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'NORMAL'
UPDATE post_comment SET status = 'WITHDRAWN' WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'NORMAL'
